mapper.insert: insert into diary (user_id, title, content, mood_type, sentiment_emotion, sentiment_score, sentiment_label, diary_date, tags) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{moodType}, #{sentimentEmotion}, #{sentimentScore}, #{sentimentLabel}, #{diaryDate}, #{tags})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, mood_type, sentiment_emotion, sentiment_score, sentiment_label, confidence, keywords, created_at, updated_at, tags FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM diary WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE diary SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, mood_type = #{moodType}, sentiment_score = #{sentimentScore}, sentiment_label = #{sentimentLabel}, sentiment_emotion = #{sentimentEmotion}, tags = #{tags} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE diary SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT mood_type AS moodType, count(*) AS value FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY mood_type

SELECT diary_date, COUNT(*) AS diary_count, ROUND(AVG(sentiment_score), 2) AS avg_score, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(mood_type ORDER BY created_at DESC), ',', 1 ) AS main_mood FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND diary_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY diary_date ORDER BY diary_date ASC
select * from diary where diary_date = #{diaryDate} and user_id = #{userId}
select diary.mood_type from diary where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0 and diary_date >= DATE_SUB(now(), interval #{days} day)
select diary.mood_type from diary where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0

SELECT jt.tag FROM diary d, JSON_TABLE(d.tags, '$[*]' COLUMNS (tag VARCHAR(20) PATH '$')) jt WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.diary_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND d.tags IS NOT NULL AND JSON_LENGTH(d.tags) > 0 GROUP BY jt.tag ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(d.created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT diary_date) AS recordDays, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND diary_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND diary_date <= CURDATE()

SELECT mood_type AS moodType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND diary_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND diary_date <= CURDATE() GROUP BY mood_type ORDER BY cnt DESC, MAX(created_at) DESC LIMIT 1
